description: Template that sets the defaults and rules for a family of cohorts: default visibility and size, whether members auto-enroll into a backing course, and whether leaders may split their cohort.

fields.description: The relational shape of cohorts of this type.
fields.label: Category

fields.description: When a cohort of this type graduates, the type its members flow into next (e.g. Student → Alumni-Peer). Optional.
fields.label: Graduates To

fields.description: Optional program context for cohorts of this type.
fields.label: Program

fields.description: Backing course. When set together with Auto-Enroll on Join, a joining member is enrolled into this course and billed like any other course enrollment. Should be one of the program's courses.
fields.label: Course

fields.description: Auto-enroll a joining member (with an active Program Enrollment) into the backing course.
fields.label: Auto-Enroll on Join

fields.description: Members may join without a leader invite.
fields.label: Open Enrollment

fields.description: Leaders may split / multiply a cohort of this type.
fields.label: Allow Self-Split

fields.description: Default reach for new posts. Members may still choose private/direct per post. There is no anonymous tier.
fields.label: Default Visibility

fields.description: Soft ceiling on active members (0 = unlimited).
fields.label: Default Max Size

name: Cohort Type
